title: Token Managers Configuration
description: Configuration file for token manager address assignments. The zero address (0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000) is used as a special sentinel value for application-level access control, not as a valid token contract address.

tokenAddress.description: Token contract address or special address (e.g., zero address for system-level permissions)

metadata.description: Additional metadata about the token and manager

setAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the manager was set

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the manager was last updated

deprecated.description: Deprecated token manager entries preserved for audit purposes

transferAddress.description: ENS name of the primary transfer address

transferAddressHex.description: Hex representation of the primary transfer address

lastUpdated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of last configuration update

version.description: Semantic version of the configuration schema
